title: Revolut integrates its crypto exchange with AI assistants as agentic trading spreads
dc:creator: Naga Avan-Nomayo
description: Revolut X now connects to Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, and Cursor, letting crypto users analyze, backtest, and execute trades via AI prompts.
